heading: 参考资料

sources.title: Introduction
supports: 生产者向topic的某分区追加事件，消费者读取并处理。
消费后不删除记录，记录保留受topic配置约束。
顺序保证限定同一分区。

verification.method: Complete HTTPS GETs of official Apache Kafka fixed-commit GitHub raw bytes through configured proxy with default TLS verification. Read frontmatter, mechanism paragraphs and same-commit API/config source. No canonical kafka.apache.org HTML was fetched or claimed verified.

quotation.text: Events in a topic can be read as often as needed-unlike traditional messaging systems, events are not deleted after consumption.

sources.title: Design
supports: 消费者按分区记录下一条消息的位置。
本例先处理再保存进度，失败窗口可能重读，不保证任意业务恰好一次。

acks=all等待当前ISR；最少ISR条件另受topic配置约束。
